meta.title: Provider SDK Module
meta.summary: Owned ArtifactSource、端口共享内容、逐端口验证与 terminal 可见性

cards.title: Shared output content
cards.body: Distinct ports may share one complete ArtifactRef and one blob. Keep every role and validator; charge each logical output and retained buffer. Same-port duplicates or conflicting identities fail.

cards.title: Forbidden boundary
cards.body: Provider never receives mutable Project or bundle path.

cards.title: Verified output reader
cards.body: Read only a successful terminal output binding under an explicit byte bound. Verify regular file, length and SHA-256; return owned bytes without exposing private paths or modifying terminal evidence.
